Generate an Alphanumeric Survey Index Grid over an Area of Interest

Source: R/vantor_fieldwork.R
vantor_survey_grid.Rd

Partitions an Area of Interest (AOI) into a regular grid of square or hexagonal enumeration cells with human-readable alphanumeric index labels ("A1", "A2", "B1", etc.), cell centroids (centroid_lon, centroid_lat), and area in square meters (area_m2). Designed for planning field enumeration areas, printing map book index sheets with vantor_field_atlas(), and stratified spatial sampling.

Usage

vantor_survey_grid(
  aoi,
  cell_size = 500,
  shape = c("square", "hexagonal"),
  clip_to_aoi = TRUE,
  crs = 4326,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

aoi

A spatial object (sf, sfc, bbox, SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent, stars, stars_proxy) or a numeric bounding box vector of length 4 (c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in EPSG:4326).

cell_size

Numeric. Target width/diameter of each grid cell in meters (computed in Web Mercator EPSG:3857). Default is 500 (500 m).

shape

Character string. Grid cell geometry: "square" (default) or "hexagonal".

clip_to_aoi

Logical. If TRUE (default) and aoi is an sf, sfc, or SpatVector polygon, retains only grid cells that spatially intersect the aoi geometry.

crs

Numeric or character. Output Coordinate Reference System for the returned sf grid. Default is 4326 (EPSG:4326).

verbose

Logical. Print status messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

An sf polygon object with columns:

  • cell_id: Alphanumeric grid label ("A1", "A2", ..., "B1", ...)

  • row_idx: Row index (top-to-bottom, 1-based)

  • col_idx: Column index (left-to-right, 1-based)

  • centroid_lon, centroid_lat: Cell centroid coordinates in EPSG:4326

  • area_m2: Approximate planar area in square meters

  • geometry: Polygon geometry in crs

Examples

aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -104.99, ymax = 39.75),
  crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
)
grid_sf <- vantor_survey_grid(aoi, cell_size = 500, verbose = FALSE)
head(grid_sf)
